summary: A stroke survivor was groomed via WhatsApp and video calls into sending about 11000 dollars in crypto to a fake investment site that demanded escalating fees and taxes and after contact was cut the scammers issued death threats and sextortion style threats against the family.
user_mistake: Sending crypto and identity documents to an online investment operator and paying repeated fee demands
prevention: Stop all contact and report threats to local police cybercrime unit / Preserve all chats and transaction evidence for banks and investigators
